A Sprinkle of Recklessness.description: Lowers a marked ally's helpful-skill cost or raises a marked enemy's harmful-skill cost by 1 {generic} for 1 turn; the ally gains Elemental Essence if they use a new skill.

A Tale of Joy and Wonder.description: Keeper of Fables' allies gain Elemental Essence when they use a new skill.

Acceleration Serum.description: After 3 turns, this enemy takes 40 affliction damage.

Acted.description: Records that Gommar used a skill this turn, suppressing Natural Cryogenics' idle heal.

Aerie Essence Override.description: While Syl's starting Shield holds, she always triggers Two as One when she uses a skill.

Apprenticeborn Pathogen.description: Deals 5 damage when applied, lowers the target's damage by 10 the next turn, then stuns them on the final turn.

Arcadia, Enraged.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies each turn for 4 turns; while active, Thorn Prick costs nothing and deals 5 more initial damage.

Arcadian Advancement.description: Each time an ally triggers Prance, Titania's effects permanently last one additional turn.

Arcadian Target.description: This enemy is marked as the target of an Arcadian skill.

Banner of Consecration.description: For 2 turns, anyone who damages Taryn or his allies takes 10 damage.

Banner of Harmony.description: For 1 turn, any Harmful skill this enemy uses is reflected to Taryn.

Blackened Wounds.description: This enemy ignores all healing for 1 turn.

Blessed Leylines.description: This ally is Invulnerable for 1 turn and permanently receives 5 more healing from all sources.

Blood in the Water.description: Holds stored damage; River Daughter's Blood in the Water skill spends it to deal extra damage.

Bloodrose Offering.description: For 1 turn, if this ally dies, Maggie heals 10 HP per stack of Curse of Thorns on her.

Bog Witch's Bargain.description: If this enemy uses a new skill, it takes 35 Affliction damage and permanently ignores non-damage effects; otherwise it is stunned and Maggie heals 35 HP.

Boon: Save Your Friends.description: For 1 turn, this Hero's next Helpful skill heals its targets 15 HP and makes them Invulnerable; using a different skill instead ends this and permanently Isolates the Hero.

Bottled Flame.description: Pyrrha holds Bottled Flame for 3 turns.

Bounty.description: Allies who deal damage to this enemy are healed for 10 health.

Bramblelash.description: Until the end of Maggie's next turn, if this enemy takes new damage, Maggie gains Elemental Essence.

Brimsteel Scabbard.description: Jarrik's next Blade of Ashes deals triple damage, cannot be countered, and creates a Cinderling minion if it strikes an enemy affected by Cinders.

Brittle Ice.description: Each stack lowers Iceblood Hammer's damage by 5, stacking up to twice.

Burning Blood Serum.description: Dennis deals 10 more damage and takes 10 damage per turn, for each stack.

Burning Order.description: This Summer Courtesan deals triple damage this turn.

Bypass.description: Damage dealt to this unit ignores Invulnerability, Damage Reduction, and Shield.

Call Tides.description: A counter on Zev'kir; his water skills grow stronger with each stack of Call Tides.

Capacitor Upgrade.description: Ando's Expel Energy deals 5 more damage per stack; all stacks are removed when Expel Energy is used.

Catalytic Nova.description: Your next Ripple deals 10 more damage for each stack.

Catalytic Nova Chain.description: Increases the damage of River Daughter's next Ripple by 10 per stack; she gains Elemental Essence if Catalytic Nova is used again next turn.

Chains of Atlantis.description: This enemy takes 5 Affliction damage per stack during each turn of Call Tides.

Channel Earth.description: A stack Gaia accumulates; several of her skills scale with how many times Channel Earth has been used.

Channel Vitality.description: Whenever one of Gaia's minions acts this turn, this ally is healed 10 HP.

Charged.description: While Charged, Ando's skills are augmented.

Chorus.description: Stays active while at least one of Ayana's two Angel minions is alive; ends when both are killed.

Chronicle Deeds.description: If this enemy uses a new skill this turn, Tales to Tell gains 35 Shield.

Chronicle Fragments.description: When Tales to Tell's Shield breaks from damage, Keeper of Fables gains a Fragment; his abilities spend Fragments as 10 Shield each.

Cinders.description: This enemy can be Shattered by Cinderswell and takes Affliction from Call Cinders.

Cinders Proc Lock.description: Once-per-turn lock so Cinders' bonus Affliction damage and Elemental Essence trigger only once each turn.

Cloister.description: For 1 turn, the Damage Reduction from Revered Daughter is doubled.

Cold and Alone.description: This enemy gains a stack each turn while Invulnerable or Isolated, and is stunned for 1 turn upon reaching 3 stacks.

Compound Eyes.description: Titania cannot be Blinded, Stunned, or have her costs changed.

Concealed.description: Records that a hidden skill stays concealed until it triggers; nothing reads this.

Corrosive Slam.description: This unit is charging a 15 Affliction hit on the enemy team next turn; taking damage cancels it.

Curse of Darkness.description: This character takes 15 Affliction damage and one stack of Deepening Shadows each turn; if it never uses a skill, Curse of Darkness copies to an ally at its current duration.

Curse of Fealty.description: For 3 turns, this unit deals 5 less non-Affliction damage and the Black Knight deals 5 more damage.

Curse of Thorns.description: Each stack deals Maggie 5 Affliction damage every turn for the rest of the game.

Cursed Gift.description: Any healing this target receives for the next 3 turns is dealt as Affliction damage instead.

Dancing Lights.description: While active, Blade of Ashes targets all enemies and Jarrik automatically creates a Cinderling whenever he triggers his Cinders.

Dazzling Lights.description: The first enemy to use a skill on Gommar while he is Frost-Covered has its skill costs increased by 1 {generic} for 1 turn.

Dead or Alive.description: The Black Knight ignores all new Harmful skills for 1 turn.

Deal: Defeat Your Enemies.description: This Hero deals 10 more non-Affliction damage for 1 turn, but takes 20 Affliction damage if they use a new skill.

Deal: Realize Your Potential.description: Until the end of their next turn, this Hero's skills cost 1 less Specific and 1 less Generic energy; using a new skill stuns them for 1 turn.

Deal: Save Your Friends.description: For 1 turn, this Hero's next Helpful skill heals its targets 15 HP and makes them Invulnerable for 1 turn; using any other new skill instead ends this and permanently Isolates the Hero.

Deepening Shadows.description: At the end of each of Laria's turns she gains a stack of Deepening Shadows, but only while she has fewer than 3.

Deja Vu Watch.description: This enemy is marked for 1 turn; if the mark expires while still on them, their cooldowns are paralyzed for 2 turns.

Direct Energy Line.description: Whenever Saya gains Elemental Essence she heals 10 Health, and cannot be healed otherwise.

Disarming Pitch.description: For 1 turn, any enemy who uses a new skill on Scratch becomes marked for 1 turn.

Dive.description: River Daughter is under the effect of Dive.

Dive Ripple.description: Next turn, Ripple lasts two turns, Undertow targets all enemies, and River Clone costs 1 {generic}.

Dive Undertow.description: Next turn, Ripple lasts two turns, Undertow hits all enemies, and River Clone costs 1 {generic}.

Divine Ire.description: Ayana deals 5 more Voice of Light damage to this enemy per stack; a stack is gained whenever they damage her allies.

Divinity Engine.description: For Sera's next 2 turns she ignores non-damage effects; during this time Synthetic Skyblade consumes an extra Eyes of Vengeance stack when possible and grants her Shield equal to its damage.

Drakken.description: Jarrik can no longer apply, trigger, or consume Cinders.

Drop of Moonglove.description: For 1 turn, if this enemy is healed, they permanently ignore healing and take 15 Affliction damage each turn for the rest of the round.

EMG Armed.description: Scratch's next non-Ultimate Deal skill will also cast his other two Deal skills.

EMG Fired.description: Internal flag marking that this once-only effect has already fired.

Eagle Acted.description: Internal marker recording that Syl's Eagle has acted this turn.

Earth Pillar.description: This enemy is marked with an Earth Pillar for Roland's next two turns; several of his skills act on marked enemies.

Echoes of Desire.description: The next skill this ally uses will occur twice.

Electroblade.description: This enemy is marked by Electroblade, singling them out as a target for Ando's Electroblade skills.

Endless Night.description: Every skill used by the allied team is Invisible.

Enhanced.description: Saya's next skill is Enhanced, triggering its added effect.

Enhanced Saya Coil.description: Deals 20 damage to a random enemy at the end of every turn.

Ethereal Form.description: The turn after the Black Knight ignores a skill, he deals 10 additional damage.

Evencoin.description: This character is treated as having triple their actual stacks of Deepening Shadows.

Evencoin Given.description: Records that a killing blow has already granted an Evencoin this battle.

Execution Sentence.description: Jarrik can no longer be stunned or countered.

Exile.description: This unit is Exiled; using a skill normally ends Exile.

Eyes of Vengeance.description: This enemy gains a stack whenever it uses a non-Invisible Harmful skill on Sera or her allies.

Faustian Bargain.description: Scratch's next deal will not apply its positive effect to enemies or its Triggered effect to allies.

Faustian: no-trigger.description: Internal marker tracking that this Deal has not yet been triggered.

Final Breath.description: The first time Jarrik would die, he instead becomes Immortal for one turn.

Five Plagues.description: When Titania deals Affliction damage to an enemy, each stack gives a 10% chance to apply a random debuff.

Flames of Judgment.description: Enemies gain a stack when they damage Pyrrha via Fan the Flames or use a skill on Pyrrha or her allies.

Flat Design.description: This ally was already aided by Character Development this round, so aiding it again gives Keeper no Elemental Essence.

Forced Harmony.description: If this target deals new damage to Taryn's allies, it takes double damage from Taryn's next Inspiring Thrust.

Fox Fire.description: For 4 turns, each time the marked unit uses or receives a new Harmful skill, an enemy takes 5 Affliction damage or an ally heals 5 HP; a new skill used on Fate gives him Elemental Essence.

Fox's Cunning.description: For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill becomes affected by Fox Fire.

Frost-Covered.description: Enhances Gommar's skills; if he damages an enemy that has reduced damage, he gains Elemental Essence.

Gift Malice.description: While active, Gift from the Fae uses its harmful version.

Godly Wisdom.description: Every 3rd time enemies trigger Voice of Light or Prayer, Ayana automatically uses Voice of Glory.

Grasping Vines.description: Next turn this enemy takes 15 damage; if they use a skill first, they are also stunned for 1 turn.

Guardian Suppressed.description: Protector of the Song's automatic activation is suppressed for 1 turn because Taryn dealt damage.

HS-112 Fury Serum.description: For 4 turns, any unit Dennis damages and any unit that damages him is Taunted for 1 turn.

HS-46 Ascendant Serum.description: Dennis ignores non-damage effects for 1 turn, and Big Green Fist deals 10 more damage until the end of his next turn.

HS-88 Reconstitution Serum.description: Dennis heals 5 HP each turn per stack.

Hallowed Proc Lock.description: Internal marker that stops Hallowed Footsteps' bonus from triggering more than once per hit.

Hand of Michael.description: Next turn, this enemy takes 30 damage; if they use a harmful skill first, it is Countered and they take 15 more.

Heavenly Parry.description: If this enemy uses a new Harmful skill, it takes 25 Piercing damage and gains a stack of Eyes of Vengeance. This effect is invisible.

Hive Formation.description: For 4 turns, this ally gains Compound Eyes, and Titania's Barbed Wit Taunt can redirect to a random Hive Formation ally.

Hunger for Battle: Fed.description: The Black Knight deals 5 more damage whenever he deals damage; this stacks and is removed if he ends a turn dealing none.

Hysteria Serum.description: This enemy is permanently Isolated and takes 20 Affliction damage if it uses a Helpful skill.

Icebite Briars.description: For 4 turns, enemies Maggie damages deal 5 less non-Affliction damage for 1 turn, and Curse of Thorns does not damage her.

Iced Shelf.description: Keeper of Fables and the target enemy are stunned until a Helpful or Harmful skill is used on either; ending it for one ends it for all.

Icy Shrapnel.description: When this mark expires next turn, this enemy takes 20 damage.

Icy Smile.description: If this enemy takes new damage this turn, they are stunned and the damaging ally gains Elemental Essence.

In Between CD.description: Cooldown marker: In Between's Harmful-effect ignore cannot trigger again for 2 turns.

Inspiring Thrust.description: This turn, any ally who uses a new harmful skill on this enemy gains Elemental Essence.

King's Saddle.description: For 3 turns, Bjorn, True King is stunned and redirects damage Gommar would take to himself; if Gommar consumes Frost-Covered, Bjorn casts Sovereign's Howl on a random enemy.

Know Your Fate.description: For 3 turns, this Hero ignores non-damage effects and their skills cost nothing; at the end, the Hero is killed.

Lens.description: This Prismari Ranger is using their Lens; an allied Ranger can reflect their skill through it.

Lens Applied.description: Counts the Lens skills that have been used on this enemy this turn.

Lens Target.description: This enemy is the Prismari Rangers' Lens target; their reflected and redirected skills strike it.

Lens of the Deep.description: For its next two turns, this enemy takes double damage from reflected skills.

Leyline Decay Suppressed.description: Leyline Nest's cost no longer decreases each turn; instead it drops by 1 {generic} each time Syl gains Elemental Essence.

Light of Raphael.description: For 3 turns, Zephyrex has 20 Shield and Elegant Sweep hits instantly.

Lightning Rod.description: Saya deals 5 damage to a random enemy per stack; she gains a stack whenever she gains energy from Elemental Essence.

Lingering Spores.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage per turn per stack if this is an enemy, or heals 5 per turn per stack if an ally.

Living Stone.description: At the end of each of Roland's turns, he gives 10 Shield to a random ally; if that Shield breaks, he gains Elemental Essence.

Magnetized.description: This Boulder taunts all enemies for 1 turn, then next turn deals double damage to any enemy it damages.

Mammon's Flame.description: Each use raises Mammon's Flame's cost by 1 {generic} and its damage to the target and Pyrrha by 10.

Mark the Path.description: Allies Bypass when targeting this enemy.

Marked.description: When a marked target triggers one of Scratch's Deal skills, Scratch gains Elemental Essence; if a Deal expires untriggered, its target gains Elemental Essence.

Mentorship.description: For 3 turns, this ally gains 5 increased damage and 5 Damage Reduction, and gains Elemental Essence when they deal damage, take damage, are stunned, or become invulnerable.

Mentorship: dealt.description: Tales to Tell's Shield stops protecting Keeper of Fables; when he dies, allies split that Shield.

Mentorship: invuln.description: Internal flag: Tales to Tell's Shield no longer protects Keeper of Fables, and on his death his allies split that Shield.

Mentorship: stunned.description: Internal flag marking that this mentored ally already earned Elemental Essence from being stunned.

Mentorship: taken.description: Tales to Tell's Shield no longer protects Keeper of Fables; when he dies, his allies split that Shield.

Mindfog Serum.description: For 3 turns, Dennis's cooldowns rise by 1 and he ignores stuns and counters, while Lumbering Smash stuns its targets' non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

Mirage Trap: Strategic.description: Aramao counters the first Strategic skill this enemy uses within 1 turn.

Mirage Trap: non-Strategic.description: Aramao will counter the first non-Strategic skill this enemy uses.

Mooncursed.description: This character's Strategic skills are stunned, it deals 5 more non-Affliction damage, and it suffers 10 Affliction damage per turn.

Mutated Strain.description: A mutated Apprenticeborn Pathogen whose effects run in reverse order, with double the damage reduction and five times the damage.

Nightcloak Candle.description: This ally's skills deal 5 more non-Affliction damage; enemies who use a harmful skill on them take 5 Affliction damage and are marked by Nightcloak Candle.

Not Today.description: For 1 turn, harmful skills aimed at this ally are reflected to Taryn instead.

Oathbreaker Primary.description: Internal marker tagging Oathbreaker's primary target so the splash damage skips it.

Ominous Rumble.description: This enemy is automatically targeted by Arcadian Duet and Jolt, consuming the mark.

Once More: Revived.description: Internal marker recording that this Hero has already been revived, preventing another revival.

Opposites Attract.description: For 1 turn, helpful skills on this enemy redirect to Ando, and damaging skills on Ando redirect to this enemy.

Overclock.description: For 3 turns, after Ando uses a Supercharged skill he becomes Charged and gains Elemental Essence.

Overwatch.description: This enemy is an Overwatch target; Orbital Strike deals 20 Bypassing damage to all Overwatch-marked enemies.

Pain Tolerance.description: Dennis gains a stack when damaged; each stack increases Big Green Fist's damage by 5.

Pain Tolerance Essence.description: Blocks Dennis from gaining Elemental Essence again from Pain Tolerance until his next turn.

Panacea Cycle.description: Every 3 turns, Ayana is cleansed of all enemy effects at the end of her turn.

Panic Armed.description: Saya's next Stroke of Genius detonates all her inventions, dealing 10 Piercing damage to a random enemy and granting 10 Shield per device detonated.

Panic Spent.description: Bookkeeping marker that Saya has spent Panic via Stroke of Genius.

Perfect Execution.description: Each stack permanently increases Perfect Execution's damage by 15, gained each time it is used.

Perfection.description: Zephyrex holds Perfection until the end of his next turn; if it expires, Perfect Execution is disabled for the rest of the round.

Perfection Locked.description: Perfect Execution is disabled for the rest of the round because Perfection expired.

Personal Magnetism.description: For 1 turn, Saya counters this enemy's first Helpful or Harmful skill; on success it loses Elemental Essence and gains a matching Magnetic Charge.

Plasma Charge.description: Saya gains 40 shield and ignores affliction damage for 1 turn.

Prance.description: Counts each time Titania gains or gives Elemental Essence through Prance.

Prance Watch.description: The first unit to use a new skill on Titania this turn gains Elemental Essence.

Prayer.description: If this ally receives new damage next turn, Ayana gains Elemental Essence.

Prism Sentence.description: This enemy is stunned, takes double damage from Voice of Light, and casting Voice of Light on it also hits the enemy team, Bypassing.

Prisma Launch: Bypass.description: An internal marker for Prisma Launch with no direct effect on its own.

Prisma Vault.description: Crimson Crash deals 15 additional damage to this marked enemy.

Prisma Whirl.description: For one turn, the first enemy to use a Harmful skill receives 10 Piercing damage.

Prisma Whirl Barrage.description: While active, every enemy that uses a Harmful skill takes 10 Piercing damage.

Prod.description: Increases the damage of the next skill this enemy uses on Zephyrex by 10 (does not stack).

Protect Me!.description: Harmful skills used on Hector are reflected to Dennis for 1 turn.

Radiant Glory.description: For 3 turns, using Stalwart Shield or Inspiring Thrust also casts Refrain on the target.

RangersAlive.description: This Hero is Untargetable, ignores damage and Harmful effects, and dies only when all three Rangers are dead.

Reanimated.description: This revived ally has their Strategic skills permanently stunned.

Refrain.description: On an enemy, stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn; on an ally, heals them 15 whenever they use a skill for 2 turns.

Repulse.description: Zev'kir counters the first harmful skill this ally receives; if countered, he begins channeling Call Tides.

Rev Uses.description: Counts Rev's uses, up to 3, escalating how many Capacitor Upgrade stacks it generates.

Rising Geyser.description: For 3 turns, this enemy replicates all new damage it receives to other Rising Geyser-marked targets.

Rising Indignation.description: Gaia's Fury costs 1 {generic} less per stack; at 3 stacks, Gaia's Fury is cast automatically.

Ritual Power.description: A Ritual accumulates Ritual Power; reaching its threshold triggers the Ritual's effect.

Ritual Unleashed.description: Whenever Elemental Essence is gained, Xyris gains 5 Ritual Power; at 75, all units' skill cooldowns drop by 1.

Ritual of Agony.description: Gains 4 Ritual Power whenever a unit takes damage or dies; at 75 Power, all units permanently take double damage.

River Clone.description: Counters the first harmful skill this enemy uses; this effect is invisible.

Sacred Grove.description: Heals this ally 5 health per turn until they use a Harmful skill; anyone who damages them becomes marked by Sacred Grove.

Saya Coil.description: Deals 10 damage to a random enemy at the end of every turn; Saya can have up to 3 Saya Coils active at once.

Scan of the All-Knowing.description: For 1 turn, Eyes of Vengeance also triggers from Strategic skills.

Shadow Cross.description: Until the end of the turn, Shadow Strike deals 10 more damage to this enemy.

Shadow Rebound.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on this ally is reflected back to its user; hidden until it triggers.

Shadow Seekers.description: For 2 turns, if this enemy takes new damage from Syl or her Eagle, their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn and the mark is removed.

Silent Avenger.description: If an allied Hero is killed, Ando immediately becomes Supercharged for his next two turns, and this Supercharge is not consumed by his abilities.

Singularity.description: For 2 turns, Ando casts Electroblade on enemies attempting Invulnerability and Flash Step on enemies using harmful skills.

Skylance Empowered.description: This turn, Syl's Skylance deals an additional 15 damage.

Somersault: Prisma Launch.description: Internal flag noting a Prisma Launch somersault has fired this turn.

Somersault: Prisma Vault.description: An internal marker for Somersault with no direct effect on its own.

Somersault: Prisma Whirl.description: Records that Prisma Whirl marked Prisma Crimson; holding all three Somersault marks makes Crimson Crash deal 40 more damage.

Somnic Watch.description: Xyris counters this enemy's next Harmful skill for 1 turn, then creates a Dream Reflection minion copying it.

Soulsteal.description: For 3 turns, this enemy becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn at the end of each of their turns.

Spectral Growth.description: This enemy gains a stack whenever it uses a Strategic skill; Maggie's damaging skills remove the stacks to heal her 5 HP per stack.

Spider Mine.description: If this enemy uses a new skill, its attached spider mine detonates for 15 damage.

Spirit Away.description: For Laria's next two turns, triggering In Between also applies its effects to this hero; if an enemy, they first take 25 true damage.

Stalwart Shield.description: Harmful skills aimed at this ally are reflected to Taryn instead.

Stonefield Stalker.description: A charge Roland accumulates from using Earth Pillar or launching Boulders with Strength From The Earth.

Stoneform.description: While marked, Boulders launched with Strength From The Earth deal double damage.

Stun Immunity.description: Jarrik cannot be stunned or countered.

Sulphur Vent.description: Counters the first enemy to use a skill on Pyrrha this turn; if countered, adds a Fan the Flames stack.

Supercharged.description: Ando is Supercharged, giving his skills their Supercharged effects for 1 turn.

Sweet Torment.description: Maggie deals 5 more non-Affliction damage per stack.

Syl Acted.description: Tracks that Syl has acted this turn, used to check whether she and her Eagle acted together.

TINTE Armed.description: For 2 turns, the first time Fate or an ally would die they return to 40 HP, then heal 5 HP per active Fox Fire; once per round.

TINTE Spent.description: Internal marker recording that Fate's TINTE has been spent.

The Nightmare Rides.description: For 2 turns, the Black Knight is invulnerable, and Oathbreaker Strike targets all enemies and is always enhanced.

The Storm Builds.description: Galazax's damaging skills apply a stack of The Storm Builds.

The Whimsy Engine.description: For 1 turn, whenever a unit uses a new skill, it instead uses a random one of its skills at random targets.

This Is Not The End.description: For 2 turns, the first time Fate or an ally would die they return to 40 HP, then heal 5 HP per active Fox Fire; triggers once per round.

To Your Health!.description: For 2 turns, if this enemy uses a skill, they take 15 Affliction damage and are stunned for 1 turn; if it ends untriggered, Hector and the enemy team heal 15 HP.

To the Skies.description: This turn, Talon Rake stuns its target for 1 turn and gains 1 cooldown, and Soar lasts an additional turn and extends this effect.

Trial of the Sands.description: For 3 turns, allied Heroes are Veiled at the end of each turn, and Aramao uses Desert Knife on any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him.

Twisted Nightmares.description: For 1 turn, this enemy's AOE skills become single-target.

Undertow Stun.description: Next turn, Undertow will stun its target for 1 turn.

Universal Energy Conduit.description: A random allied Hero will gain Elemental Essence.

variant.text: A random allied Hero will gain Elemental Essence and their skills will cost 1 less {generic} for 1 turn.

Verse of Accusation.description: Until the end of Taryn's next turn, Banner of Harmony affects all enemies.

Voice of Glory.description: Voice of Light and Prayer permanently last 1 additional turn each; this effect stacks.

Voice of Light.description: If this enemy deals new damage this turn, Ayana gains Elemental Essence.

Will-o'-wisp.description: Fate's team gains 10 Shield for 2 turns; enemies using a new Harmful skill on them take 10 Affliction damage.

Wind Dancer.description: Lowers this enemy's non-Affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn; if they use a new harmful skill during it, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence.

Wind Step Window.description: Internal timing window for triggering Wind Step.

Wraith in White.description: For 2 turns Pyrrha ignores non-damage effects, and using Pyrokinesis on an enemy first uses Fan the Flames.

chargeHandled.description: Internal flag marking that Ando's charge state has been handled this turn.

noOverclockConvert.description: Internal flag that stops Ando's Overclock from converting his Charge state during this step.
